claim: The Living Map (Founder Console -> Living Map) — Vera's operational digital twin. A served, auth-gated, READ-ONLY node/edge graph (GET /founder/living-map page + GET /founder/living-map/state data) showing how data, memory, sources, models, safety gates, capabilities, host resources, patterns and decisions move through Vera. MILESTONE 1 (STATIC REAL MAP): ~27 real subsystem nodes (User, Chat, Route Classifier, Context Immune, History, Memory, Known Facts, Sources, Intake, OCR, LERF, Pattern Observatory, Improvement Engine, Prompt Compiler, Model Runtime, Ollama, Final Output Gate, Capability Truth, Approval Queue, Identity Sandbox, Agency Suggest-Only, Security/Quarantine, Incident Lockdown, Audit/Program Reality, Argus Host Telemetry, Queues/Jobs, Founder Console) and ~36 real flows (edges). EVERY node's status is BACKED by a real source named in its source_of_truth and resolved live from real telemetry (host pressure, the live-path audit matrix, caps, security events, quarantine, MRI, patterns, improvements) — a node with no live data is honestly 'unknown', NEVER a fake green. NO WALLPAPER: status is DERIVED (patching a real source flips the dependent node's status) and CANNOT DRIFT (a node metric equals the real store). Read-only: building the map never mutates Vera state. Auth-gated. Honest bottlenecks (yellow/red nodes with a real reason) are surfaced, not invented.
owner: anima/living_map/ (schema.py topology + source_of_truth, graph.py live-status resolvers), anima/server.py (_living_map_data + GET /founder/living-map + GET /founder/living-map/state), anima/web/living_map.html, scripts/certify_living_map.py, scripts/certify_living_map_no_wallpaper.py

killer_test.name: static_real_map_served_authed_real_status_honest_unknown_no_wallpaper_read_only
killer_test.setup: scripts/certify_living_map.py (LIVING MAP STATIC: GREEN) proves /founder/living-map serves the page and /founder/living-map/state is behind the auth wall; the graph returns >= 20 real nodes (full shape) + >= 20 real edges; status loads from real telemetry; a subsystem with no live data is 'unknown'; building the map is read-only; the page renders nodes/edges/side-panel/modes + each node's source of truth. scripts/certify_living_map_no_wallpaper.py (LIVING MAP NO-WALLPAPER: GREEN) proves every coloured node has a non-empty source_of_truth, status is DERIVED (host pressure -> Argus + Model Runtime follow), node metrics EQUAL the real stores (audit == live-path matrix, caps_on == caps.load), uninstrumented subsystems are 'unknown', and the page has no fabricated green node literals.
killer_test.prompt: open Founder Console -> Living Map — click a node, see what it does + its real source of truth

known_gaps: Milestone 1 is the STATIC real map (real nodes/edges/status, no animation). Milestones 2-5 are queued: LIVE event pulses (animate real recent events), REPLAY (replay one turn/Rover run by trace_id), SIMULATION (pull a lever -> predicted impact with assumptions + confidence + required cert, sandboxed), and the Pattern/Improvement overlay. OCR per-run metrics and background-job-queue depth are not yet instrumented — surfaced honestly as 'unknown', not faked.
